world-gdrive-sync.sharedWorlds.title: Shared Worlds
world-gdrive-sync.sharedWorlds.connectFi: Connect the group's shared Google account first. Open settings (the gear button) and press Connect Google.
world-gdrive-sync.sharedWorlds.empty: No Shared Worlds yet. Share one of your worlds to start.
world-gdrive-sync.play.title: Starting %s
world-gdrive-sync.play.refused.title: Someone Is Hosting
world-gdrive-sync.play.refused: %s is hosted by %s right now. Join them through Essential, or wait until they save and quit.
world-gdrive-sync.takeOver.title: Stale Lock
world-gdrive-sync.takeOver.message:
%s is still locked by %s, but their game hasn't checked in for %s. They may have crashed or lost their connection.

Take Over and host it yourself, or Wait for them to come back and save properly?
world-gdrive-sync.takeOver.warning.title: Take Over?
world-gdrive-sync.takeOver.warning: Any progress %s made since their last upload may be lost. You will start from the latest Current Save in Google Drive.
world-gdrive-sync.upload.title: Uploading Shared World…
world-gdrive-sync.upload.failed: Upload failed: %s. You still hold the Lock, so nobody else can start the world. Your progress is safe on this computer.
world-gdrive-sync.share.title: Share an Existing World
world-gdrive-sync.share.explain: The world is uploaded as a new Shared World. Your original stays in your Singleplayer list.
world-gdrive-sync.share.noWorlds: You have no singleplayer worlds to share.
world-gdrive-sync.share.worldOpen: Open in the game; close it first
world-gdrive-sync.settings.title: Shared Worlds Settings
world-gdrive-sync.settings.waitingForBro: Sign in to the shared Google account in your web browser, then come back here. If the browser didn't open, copy the link and paste it into your browser.
A Host whose game hasn't checked in for this long shows as Stale, and friends can Take Over.
world-gdrive-sync.settings.clientMissing: This build of the mod has no Google OAuth client configured, so it can't connect.
